label: Whatever is in potency in no respect is eternal in Boethius' typed sense: it…, by Direct-proof
meaning: Let x be in potency in no respect. If its life had succession (STMT-SUCCESSION-REQUIRES-POTENCY) or began or ended (STMT-LIFE-BOUNDARY-REQUIRES-POTENCY), x would be in potency in some respect, contradicting pure act; so its life is all at once and interminable. By STMT-PURE-ACT-LIVES it lives at some time. These are the three conjuncts of DEF-BOETHIAN-ETERNAL.
